title: aidd eval packs --json
description: Each domain pack's and practice skill's estimated size, every break of their templates, and each skill's and command's description length. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

sizes.description: One entry per pack or practice skill.

name.description: The pack's slug or the skill's name.

kind.description: A domain pack or a practice skill.

tokens.description: Its estimated size in tokens, at four characters a token.

references.description: Each reference file's estimated size in tokens, by its name.

problems.description: Every break of the templates or the caps; empty when there is none.

problem.description: What is wrong, in a sentence.

descriptions.description: Each skill's and team command's description length, which loads on every session.

kind.description: A skill or a team command.
